page.overview:
Who is Mr. and Mrs. Hoofington?

Mr. Hoofington and Mrs. Hoofington are male and female unicorn ponies and supporting characters in the hour-long special My Little Pony: Rainbow Roadtrip. They are a married couple of bakers/pastry sellers, residents of Hope Hollow, and former residents of Manehattan.

Unlike other Hope Hollow residents, Mr. and Mrs. Hoofington speak with an upper-class American accent typical of high-class characters such as Hoity Toity.

Later, when Pinkie Pie and Fluttershy take on the task of making food for the Rainbow Festival, they run into Mr. and Mrs. Hoofington again and ask them to be the festival's official baking team. The couple uses their own apricots in their pies, but due to Hope Hollow's lack of color, they are unable to distinguish between ripe apricots and unripe ones, usually resulting in pies that taste bad. Pinkie and Fluttershy encourage the Hoofingtons to reach out to Moody Root, whom they live next door to and whose apricots are very ripe. With Pinkie and Fluttershy's help, the Hoofingtons and Moody rekindle their friendship, with Moody agreeing to taste-test the Hoofingtons' pies. This act contributes to the progressive return of color to Hope Hollow.

Mr. and Mrs. Hoofington are characters in Gameloft's mobile game, added in the "Rainbow Roadtrip" event.
